title: crataegus pringlei var. exclusa
intro: Crataegus pringlei var. exclusa, commonly known as Pringle Hawthorn, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family, which is a type of hawthorn tree native to China. The Pringle Hawthorn has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the treatment of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective effects. The bioactive constituents of Pringle Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
